question: What should one make in solitude while intent on meditation?
premises: bahudhā rūpaṃ kuru means make form in many ways
dhyānañ ca tatparaḥ means and intent on meditation
inference: The verse instructs making form in many ways in solitude while intent on meditation.
uncertainties: whether tatparaḥ modifies subject or meditation
plain_english: In solitude, make form in many ways, intent on meditation.
